activation_boundary: A separately reviewed exact integration plus final block authority must explicitly activate it; source presence and runtime artifacts do not activate execution.
allowed_claim: Provider-free disabled producer and opening-fence evidence only; no live execution, countable R6 result, provider/add-on superiority, or activation claim.

components.commitment: One canonical JSON regular file, owner UID, mode 0600, with only version, schema, canonical_digest, and canonical_bytes.
components.io_boundary: O_CREAT|O_EXCL|O_NOFOLLOW, full write loop, file fsync, parent fsync, root/file identity checks, exact no-follow reopen, byte and SHA-256 verification.
components.opening: Reads commitment first; validates exact four-cell packet/grade order through evaluation-v3; requires immutable deterministic gates, G1/G2, conditional G3, and sealed derived metrics; only then reads and returns the private map. Output remains activation=false and countable=false.
components.private_map: One canonical JSON regular file, owner UID, mode 0600, ignored under runtime; exact fixed cells and source identities; labels are never emitted by creation or validation.
components.producer: No-argument internal-randomness producer; fixed workspace runtime root; four 128-bit lowercase-hex labels; entries canonicalized by label and rejected if duplicate, sequential, source-ordered, reverse-source-ordered, or non-opaque.

failure_radius: Creation/validation/opening of this ignored workspace-local candidate only; fail closed before map disclosure; no provider or host path is loaded.
observed_gap: Evaluation-v3 validates a supplied legacy map commitment and opening, but has no no-argument, no-replace, owner-private canonical-map producer; its test fixture uses replaceable writes and sequential aliases.
selected_scope: Add one stdlib-only pre-call producer/validator/opening wrapper; reuse evaluation-v3 gate, G1/G2, conditional G3, and metric derivation; do not modify the runner or predecessor history.

state_authority.artifact_location: module-derived fixed workspace runtime root; never caller-selected
state_authority.clock: not accepted by producer, validator, or opener
state_authority.map_and_labels: producer internal randomness only; never caller-selected
